transcript: Mard, 45 saal. Ek hafte se khansi, peela balgham, aur halka bukhar. Saans nahi phoolta. Seene ki daayin taraf awaaz aa rahi hai. Augmentin 625 din mein do baar, paanch din. Khansi ka syrup do chamach din mein teen baar. Cigarette band karni hai. Chest X-ray karwa lein.

complaints.symptom: voice change on the right side of the chest

medications.name: Augmentin
medications.dose: twice a day for five days
medications.instructions: twice a day, for five days

medications.name: cough syrup
medications.instructions: two spoons, three times a day for two days
